cssProperties.description: Critical-path bars and arrows (`criticalColor`); set `--gantt-bar-text-on-critical` with it.
cssProperties.name: --gantt-critical

cssProperties.description: Today marker and current-period highlight (`todayColor`); set `--gantt-today-label` with it.

cssProperties.description: Base font size (`fontSize`; change it through the theme API, it shapes the layout).
cssProperties.name: --gantt-font-size

cssProperties.description: Selection outline (selected bar and row) and the splitter / column-resize hover (`selectionBorder`).

cssProperties.description: Progress fill inside theme-coloured bars, drawn at `bar.progress.opacity` (`progressOverlay`).

cssProperties.name: --gantt-bar-height

cssParts.description: The legend of the timeline markers (`showLegend`).
cssParts.name: legend

cssParts.description: The box over the chart body while it loads, failed or is empty.
cssParts.name: state

slots.description: Shown in the empty state (no tasks and nothing loading); `labels.emptyState` when nothing is slotted.
slots.name: empty

members.name: tasks
members.description:
The tasks as you set them (with a data source, its items while connected), as Angular's
`series`: the chart's repairs (a missing `end`, an unknown `parentId`) stay inside the chart, so
`el.tasks = el.tasks.map(…)` never loses data.

members.name: columns
members.description: Task-list columns (`options.columns`, when set, wins); the built-in columns by default.

members.name: options
members.description: Every `GanttOptions` field. Re-assigning equal options changes nothing; the same object counts as changed.

members.name: annotations
members.description: Highlighted date ranges and markers.

members.name: darkMode
members.description: `true` / `false` / `'auto'` (follows `prefers-color-scheme`).

members.name: showToolbar
members.description: Toolbar with zoom, view-mode pills, view toggle and the Today button.

members.name: enableDrag
members.description: Bars can be dragged to new dates (per task: `task.draggable = false`).

members.name: enableResize
members.description: Bars can be resized from either end.

members.name: tooltipEnabled
members.description: Hover tooltip on bars.

members.name: showLegend
members.description: Floating legend explaining the vertical markers (today + annotations).

members.name: dataSource
members.description:
Lazy, paged loading. Pass `{ fetcher, pageSize }` or a `GanttDataSource`.
While set, it owns the task list (the `tasks` property is ignored).

members.name: renderBar
members.description: Replace or decorate the built-in bar SVG (see `GanttBarRenderer`).

members.name: loading
members.description:
You are loading the tasks: the body shows a loading skeleton while there are no rows, and the
chart is `aria-busy` (rows already shown stay).

members.name: errorMessage
members.description:
Shows the error state with this message (under `labels.errorTitle`) and a Retry button that
fires `retry`; `null` or a blank string shows none. It wins over every other state.

members.name: syncGroup
members.description:
Synchronises this chart with the other charts of a group (core `createGanttSyncGroup()`): the
timeline range, the zoom level, the horizontal scroll and the panel width, each unless the group
turns it off. The chart joins while connected and leaves when it disconnects or the group
changes. `null` (the default): not synchronised. A property only (no attribute).

members.name: zoomIn
members.description: One zoom level closer (along `options.zoomLevels`).

members.name: zoomOut
members.description: One zoom level further out.

members.name: fitToScreen
members.description:
Zoom to the finest zoom level at which every task fits the timeline viewport (the coarsest
when none does), then scroll the first task into view. The levels are the chart's: those of
`options.zoomLevels`, or the built-in presets when it is unset. Inside a sync group the tasks of
every chart of the group fit. Nothing happens without tasks or before the chart is laid out.

members.name: viewMode
members.description: Active zoom level (a `ViewMode` or a custom `zoomLevels` name).

members.name: setViewMode
members.description: Switch the zoom level: a `ViewMode` or a custom `zoomLevels` name (also the `view-mode` attribute).

members.name: view
members.description: Current view: `'split'`, `'table'` (task list only) or `'chart'` (timeline only).

members.name: setView
members.description: Switch the view: task list and timeline, the task list only, or the timeline only.

members.name: togglePanel
members.description:
Hide / show the task list (core `togglePanelView`): from `'split'` or `'table'` to the timeline
alone, from `'chart'` back to `'split'` at the panel's last width.

members.name: scrollToToday
members.description: Centre today in the timeline viewport.

members.name: scrollToDate
members.description: Centre `date` in the timeline viewport.

members.name: scrollToTask
members.description: Scroll the given task into view (vertically and horizontally).

members.name: getSelectedTasks
members.description: The selected tasks, in task order (as set: a rolled-up parent is its raw task, not its copy).

members.name: setSelectedTasks
members.description: Select exactly these task ids (fires `selection-change` when the selection changes).

members.name: clearSelection
members.description: Deselect every task.

members.name: selectAll
members.description: Select every visible task (multiple selection only).

members.name: updateTask
members.description:
Merge `patch` into the task with this id: a silent data write (no `before-change`, no history),
into the `dataSource` when there is one (so the next page keeps it), else into `tasks`.

members.name: appendTasks
members.description: Add tasks after the current ones (silently; into the `dataSource` when there is one).

members.name: undo
members.description: Undo the last change (`false` when there is nothing to undo, no history, or it was rejected or vetoed).

members.name: redo
members.description: Redo the last undone change (`false` when there is nothing to redo, or it was rejected or vetoed).

members.name: canUndo
members.description: There is a change to undo (refreshed on `history-change`; `false` while the chart keeps no history).

members.name: canRedo
members.description: There is an undone change to redo.

members.name: clearHistory
members.description: Forget every undo and redo step (task changes made elsewhere never clear the history).

members.name: addDependency
members.description:
Make `toId` depend on `fromId` (source `'api'`): validated like a drawn link (no self link,
duplicate, loop, or parent ↔ child link unless `editing.dependencies.parentChild`), vetoable,
undoable. Returns whether it was added (or handed to the app in controlled mode).

members.name: removeDependency
members.description: Remove the links from `fromId` to `toId` (only those of `type` when given; source `'api'`). Returns whether one was removed.

members.name: editCell
members.description: Open the editor of a task-list cell (`editing.cells`); `false` when that cell can't be edited.

members.name: focusTask
members.description:
Focus a task's bar (`area: 'bar'`, the default) or its task-list row (`'row'`): its collapsed
ancestors expand, its row is kept mounted and scrolled into view. The other area is used while
the view hides the requested one. Its focus ring shows even when a pointer triggered the call
(a button): `focus({ focusVisible: true })` where supported, and the bar's own ring. Returns
`false` for an unknown id.

members.name: collapseAll
members.description: Collapse every group (task with children).

members.name: expandAll
members.description: Expand every group.

members.name: setColumnVisible
members.description: Show / hide a column in both views, or only in the split panel / the table view.

members.name: toggleColumnVisible
members.description: Show a column if the view (both views by default) hides it, else hide it.

members.name: setTheme
members.description: Replace the custom theme overrides (on top of the light/dark base and `options.theme`).

members.name: patchTheme
members.description: Merge `patch` into the custom theme overrides.

members.name: resetTheme
members.description: Drop the `setTheme` / `patchTheme` overrides: back to the light/dark base plus `options.theme`.

members.name: getBarVisual
members.description: Geometry of a task's bar (position in timeline px, size, label) — e.g. to anchor a popover.

members.name: criticalIds
members.description: IDs of the tasks on the critical path (empty unless `options.criticalPath`).

members.name: getState
members.description:
Snapshot of the UI state (panel, view, zoom, column widths, collapsed rows, sort). While the
chart is narrow (`options.responsive`) the view is the one it shows when wide.

members.name: setState
members.description: Restore a state snapshot (e.g. from your backend).

events.description: A bar was moved: `{ taskId, oldStart, oldEnd, newStart, newEnd, daysMoved }`.
events.name: task-dragged

events.description: A bar was resized: `{ taskId, handle, oldStart, oldEnd, newStart, newEnd, daysDelta }`.
events.name: task-resized

events.description: The UI state changed (panel width or view, zoom, column widths, collapsed rows, sort); debounced, persisted under `options.stateKey`.
events.name: state-change

events.description: A data-source page failed after its automatic retries (`dataSource.retry()` tries again).
events.name: load-error

events.description: Retry was pressed on the error state: `{ source: 'error' }` for `errorMessage` (load again, then clear it), `{ source: 'dataSource' }` after a failed first data-source page (the element calls `dataSource.retry()`).
events.name: retry

events.description: A change is about to be applied (any edit, the API, undo / redo): `{ change, tasks }` (the proposed tasks). Cancelable: `event.preventDefault()` or `detail.preventDefault()`, synchronously, vetoes it; assigning `tasks` meanwhile counts as handled (nothing applied).
events.name: before-change

events.description: After every accepted change: `{ tasks, change, applied }`; `applied: false` in controlled mode (`editing.controlled`: set `tasks` yourself).
events.name: tasks-change

events.description: One per changed task, after the op events: `{ taskId, task, previous, fields, source }`.
events.name: task-updated

events.description: A task's progress changed: `{ taskId, oldProgress, newProgress }`.
events.name: task-progress-changed

events.description: A dependency was added: `{ fromId, toId, type, lag }`.
events.name: dependency-created

events.description: A dependency was removed: `{ fromId, toId, type, lag }`.
events.name: dependency-deleted

events.description: The undo / redo state changed: `{ canUndo, canRedo, undoLabel, redoLabel, undoCount, redoCount }`.
events.name: history-change

attributes.name: dark-mode
attributes.description: Sets `darkMode`: present or `"true"`, `"false"`, or `"auto"` (follows `prefers-color-scheme`). Removing it restores the default (`false`).

attributes.name: show-toolbar
attributes.description: Sets `showToolbar`: present = `true`, `"false"` = `false`. Removing it restores the default (`true`).

attributes.name: enable-drag
attributes.description: Sets `enableDrag`: present = `true`, `"false"` = `false`. Removing it restores the default (`true`).

attributes.name: enable-resize
attributes.description: Sets `enableResize`: present = `true`, `"false"` = `false`. Removing it restores the default (`true`).

attributes.name: tooltip-enabled
attributes.description: Sets `tooltipEnabled`: present = `true`, `"false"` = `false`. Removing it restores the default (`true`).

attributes.name: show-legend
attributes.description: Sets `showLegend`: present = `true`, `"false"` = `false`. Removing it restores the default (`false`).

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Sets `loading`: present = `true`, `"false"` = `false`. Removing it restores the default (`false`).

attributes.name: error-message
attributes.description: Sets `errorMessage`: its text (a blank one shows no error). Removing it restores the default (`null`).
The zoom level, through `setViewMode()`: a `ViewMode` or a `zoomLevels` name. Removing it changes nothing.
attributes.name: view-mode

cssStates.description: The dark theme is active (`darkMode` is `true`, or `'auto'` with a dark colour scheme).
cssStates.name: dark

cssStates.description: A bar is being dragged or resized.
cssStates.name: dragging

cssStates.description: `loading` is on, or a data-source page is loading.
cssStates.name: loading

cssStates.description: A dependency link is being drawn (`editing.dependencies`).
cssStates.name: linking
